derivedFrom: User-specified exercise; not derived from the original recording.
method: Frozen MIDI from the auditioned exercise: 45–85 BPM inclusive, +1 BPM every four 4/4 bars. Eight eighth-note positions: kick+hat, hat, snare+hat, hat, kick+hat, kick+hat, snare+hat, hat.
reproduction: dvc.yaml:render-drums-practice reproduces MIDI and MP3 from the editable event list.
